deduplicate_crystal_structures: deduplicate a pandas DataFrame of crystal structures using hash-based pre-filtering and parallel crystallographic comparison
process_structure_group_clustering: process a group of crystal structures and assign subgroup IDs using greedy clustering with StructureMatcher
configure_deduplication_tolerances: configure lattice tolerance, site tolerance, and angle tolerance parameters for crystal structure deduplication
